surfaces.part: yellow flower on a thin stem

answer.evidence: This is a loose ground decal, not a standing volume. Two leafy green clumps (rows 6-14) are shaded light to dark from the top downward. A yellow flower on a stem sits at rows 2-8. The silhouette is irregular, widening to 12 px at row 10 and narrowing to 1 px at row 14. There is no front-edge line, eave shadow, vertical south face or receding side face. The whole sprite reads as a flat top-down plate, so there is no front face of 3 or more rows.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tiny single prop of about 20x20 px (a green leaf tuft with a yellow-orange bud), not a 4x3 ground patch. It is smaller than one 16x16 tile, so the per-tile facts read 0 and I judged by eye. The references are full ground surfaces: grass with mottled tufts and dark-green patches (3 visible tones per tile), and paving with individually shaded stones (7 tones per tile). The candidate has only 11 distinct colours and about 3 green steps, against roughly 5 steps in the references. Its dark edge pixels are tinted dark green rather than neutral, so the outline leans toward dark material tone, but it still reads as a sticker-like outlined sprite. It has no ground coverage, no soil or grass grain, and no tiling surface, so it is far thinner than the references and does not deliver the requested 4x3 ground patch.
